name: birge
description: Birge — бірге кино көруге, музыка тыңдауға арналған онлайн-кинотеатр (iOS, Android, Web)

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @birge/shared && npm run test -w @birge/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @birge/shared && npm run typecheck -w @birge/server && npm run typecheck -w @birge/app
